description: This file defines a REST API router for managing class entities within a student attendance management system. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting classes, utilizing FastAPI, Pydantic models, and SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

classes.name: ClassCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a class, including name, section, and teacher_id.

classes.name: ClassUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating a class, allowing optional changes to name, section, and teacher_id.

classes.name: ClassOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for class output, representing class data returned by API endpoints.

methods.name: create_class(class_in: ClassCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new class record in the database.

methods.name: list_classes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of all classes with pagination.

methods.name: get_class(class_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch a specific class by its ID.

methods.name: update_class(class_id: int, class_in: ClassUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing class identified by its ID.

methods.name: delete_class(class_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a class by its ID.
